integrity: The exact six-polynomial law and its extremal consequences have an all-size argument based on partial-image enumeration, finite algebra and a sign-classified quartic. A standalone verifier performed 1270 exact corroborating assertions; bounded computation is not treated as infinite proof.
limitations: Only three consecutive image values in an Ewens cycle-weighted permutation are covered. No joint multiple-window theorem, longer-pattern theorem or general conjugation-invariant extension is claimed. Historical implicit derivability from more general generating functions remains a priority risk.
title: Rank-one site drift and sharp parameter extremizers for Ewens triple patterns
